mapper.select: SELECT d.disease_id, d.disease_name, NULL AS disease_name_cn, d.orpha_code AS orpha_number, NULL AS omim_id, d.locus_text AS locus, d.locus_type, dbm.cytoband_id AS band_id FROM disease_band_map dbm JOIN disease d ON d.disease_id = dbm.disease_id WHERE dbm.cytoband_id = #{bandId} ORDER BY d.disease_name, d.disease_id

SELECT DISTINCT d.disease_id, d.disease_name, NULL AS disease_name_cn, d.orpha_code AS orpha_number, NULL AS omim_id, d.locus_text AS locus, d.locus_type, dbm.cytoband_id AS band_id FROM cytoband cb JOIN chromosome chr ON chr.chromosome_id = cb.chromosome_id JOIN disease_band_map dbm ON dbm.cytoband_id = cb.cytoband_id JOIN disease d ON d.disease_id = dbm.disease_id WHERE chr.chr_name = #{chromosome} AND cb.start_bp <= #{endBp} AND cb.stop_bp >= #{startBp} ORDER BY d.disease_name, d.disease_id

SELECT d.disease_id, d.disease_name, NULL AS disease_name_cn, d.orpha_code AS orpha_number, NULL AS omim_id, d.locus_text AS locus, d.locus_type, ( SELECT dbm.cytoband_id FROM disease_band_map dbm WHERE dbm.disease_id = d.disease_id ORDER BY dbm.cytoband_id LIMIT 1 ) AS band_id FROM disease d WHERE d.disease_id = #{diseaseId} LIMIT 1

SELECT g.gene_symbol, g.gene_symbol AS gene_name, chr.chr_name AS chromosome, g.start_bp, g.end_bp, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dgm2.disease_id) FROM disease_gene_map dgm2 WHERE dgm2.gene_id = g.gene_id ) AS disease_count FROM disease_gene_map dgm JOIN gene g ON g.gene_id = dgm.gene_id LEFT JOIN chromosome chr ON chr.chromosome_id = g.chromosome_id WHERE dgm.disease_id = #{diseaseId} ORDER BY g.gene_symbol

SELECT g.gene_symbol, g.gene_symbol AS gene_name, chr.chr_name AS chromosome, COALESCE(gc.start_bp, g.start_bp) AS start_bp, COALESCE(gc.end_bp, g.end_bp) AS end_bp, COUNT(DISTINCT dgm.disease_id) AS disease_count FROM disease_band_map dbm JOIN disease_gene_map dgm ON dgm.disease_id = dbm.disease_id JOIN gene g ON g.gene_id = dgm.gene_id LEFT JOIN chromosome chr ON chr.chromosome_id = g.chromosome_id LEFT JOIN gene_coordinate gc ON gc.gene_coordinate_id = ( SELECT gc2.gene_coordinate_id FROM gene_coordinate gc2 WHERE gc2.gene_symbol = g.gene_symbol ORDER BY gc2.is_basic DESC, gc2.source_db, gc2.gene_coordinate_id LIMIT 1 ) WHERE dbm.cytoband_id = #{bandId} GROUP BY g.gene_id, g.gene_symbol, chr.chr_name, COALESCE(gc.start_bp, g.start_bp), COALESCE(gc.end_bp, g.end_bp) ORDER BY disease_count DESC, g.gene_symbol
SELECT moi_value FROM disease_moi WHERE disease_id = #{diseaseId} ORDER BY moi_value
SELECT onset_value FROM disease_onset WHERE disease_id = #{diseaseId} ORDER BY onset_value
SELECT CONCAT(link_source, ': ', link_url) FROM disease_gene_link WHERE disease_id = #{diseaseId} ORDER BY link_source, link_id
